author: blu
body: A WPF gallery of the format solver's surviving deck. The card list and title live in SolverGalleryData, a chapter regenerated by build-solver-gallery.ps1 from a real solver run (name, type + mana cost, Scryfall art URL per card). make-card / set-root are provided by the WPF plug as C# builtins -- declared here as stubs so the Codex type checker is satisfied, and skipped when the plug emits C#.
